about: Lisbon's alternative, unconference, community and side events around Web Summit 2026 (9 to 15 November), from public event pages, each with its URL and the time read; status says whether the storm (Wednesday 11 November) moved or cancelled it. For Lisbon Fringe's team (Dinis, 11 November 2026, about 10:00 UTC: board/guidance/2026-11-11-the-site-follows-the-storm-and-lisbon-fringe.md). Organisers as organisations; no private people, no contact details.
notes: No unconference found: searches for unconference, barcamp and open space around Web Summit Lisbon 2026 returned nothing public by 10:30 UTC; the nearest is the IndieSummit Lisboa meetup (a no-agenda social). If Dinis knows the 'Uncon' event's name, the next sweep looks for it.
iproxy.online's side-events list was read only in part; Thursday to Sunday events are under-counted.
